_about: What the monthly Autodesk check (scripts/autodesk-watch.ts, .github/workflows/dependencies.yml) compares against. Every pin is what was there when a person last read the changes. Move them with `npm run watch:autodesk -- --update` in a pull request, after reading the issue the check opened.

repos.why: The OpenAPI descriptions of the storage (OSS) and sign-in APIs flo2-rvt calls.
Autodesk's Node SDK; flo2-rvt's chunked upload and token request are adapted from it.
The Design Automation tutorial sample in .NET, including its Revit add-in.
Autodesk's own MCP server for Revit automation: prior art for the WorkItem and status tools.
Its AppBundle layout, entry point and registered-tool dispatch are adapted in the add-in.
Autodesk's Design Automation command line: the calls as Autodesk makes them.
Activity signing, a recorded later hardening.
The aps-docs-portal method this check reads the documentation by.
The add-in's PDF export is adapted from it.
